title: 第 20 章 首轮 大胜格局碾压全场第 19 章 系统奖励解锁防御秘术
lines: ：距离青玄宗小型比武开赛只剩一日，全宗门大大小小的弟子全都扎堆在演武广场周边，大街小巷谈论的话题绕不开即将开启的擂台赛。在天道潜移默化的舆论引导下，九成修士认定苏辰身负天命，背靠多名偏袒裁判，拿下榜首已是板上钉钉；反观陆衍，依旧被各类谣言缠身，不少人听信禁术传言，觉得他修为来路不正，登台之后很快就会被人当众打落颜面，沦为全宗门笑柄。
陆衍在陆家别院静心调整状态，《玄水护罩》经过连日打磨早已运用自如，功德源源不断滋养肉身，炼气巅峰的底蕴同阶难寻敌手。一旁赵小胖抱着厚厚一摞证据卷宗，卷宗里分门别类记着苏行贿裁判、暗中安排造谣打手、勾结天骄垄断试炼资源的全部人证物证，这是陆连日布局搜集的底牌。
“少爷，苏今天还在演武场笼络人心，不少内门天骄凑在他身边抱团，一个个都等着跟着喝汤，就盼着靠着苏的气运分到优质修炼资源。”小胖把最新打探来的消息一一禀报，脸上满是愤愤不平，“还有那几个被苏提前收买的裁判，私下已经定下首轮对阵的暗箱安排，刻意给您安排一名炼气巅峰老牌天骄出战，想要借着首轮高强度对战消耗您体力，只要交手出现半点磕碰，立马判您恶意出手违规。”
陆衍指尖轻点桌面，神色淡然，苏布局看似面面俱到，却处处留下破绽。对方想要靠裁判规则设局，自己就以守代攻，全程控招留手，不靠蛮力伤人，只用扎实功底稳稳取胜，裁判就算收了好处，当着上万弟子的目光也没法胡乱判罚。
“不用被对方的首轮针对打乱节奏，咱们按原定计划，比武场上凭实力说话，场外我已经安排此前受过恩惠的外门弟子分散在广场各处，只要苏安排的造谣团伙露头，当场抓现成。”陆早已布下天罗地网，苏准备的赛后抹黑后手，从一开始就落入圈套。
休整一夜，第二日清晨，青玄宗小型比武正式拉开帷幕。偌大演武广场座无虚席，高台之上七名裁判依次落座，其中五人眼神时不时望向苏辰的方向，隐晦示意一切按先前约定行事。苏辰一身青衫站在选手区，频频朝着围观弟子拱手示意，温润模样引得全场阵阵喝彩，漫天淡金色气运慢悠悠落在他身上，靠着众人追捧持续积攒修为。
首轮抽签结束，果不其然，陆衍的对手是内门成名天骄王浩。王常年混迹宗门小比，炼气巅峰修为扎实，出手狠辣，赛前已经收了苏送来的丹药，私下承诺上台全力猛攻，想方设法引诱陆衍暴怒出手，只要陆招式过重，立马示意裁判判罚。
抽签结果公布瞬间，全场哄笑四起，看热闹的弟子纷纷交头接耳。“这下陆完蛋，首轮就撞上硬茬，怕是撑不过十招就要惨败。”“苏师兄运气真好抽到软柿子，轻轻松松就能拿下首胜，高下一眼就能看出来。”
各类嘲讽话语此起彼伏，偏见已经扎根在绝大多数人心里。赵小胖站在陆身侧气得攥紧拳头，想要出声辩驳，被陆伸手拦下。多说无益，擂台之上用结果打破所有流言才是最优解。
很快，首轮第一场苏辰的比试率先开打，对手修为平平，苏借着天道气运加持，招式行云流水，轻轻松松两三招便拿下胜利，赢了之后还故作谦让，连连夸赞对手实力不俗，又收割一波全场好感，气运再度小幅暴涨。
轮到陆衍登台时，全场瞬间安静，密密麻麻的目光齐刷刷聚焦擂台。王浩提着长剑快步上台，眼神带着几分阴狠，一开局便催动全部灵力，凌厉剑招层层叠叠疯狂压来，剑风呼啸，摆明了要步步紧逼，逼迫陆衍仓促还手露出破绽。
台下五名被收买的裁判身体微微前倾，目光死死盯着擂台，就等着陆但凡出手偏重，立刻敲响判罚铜锣。围观弟子屏住呼吸，大多等着看陆衍狼狈落败的窘态。
就在凌厉剑锋快要近身的瞬间，淡青色玄水护罩瞬间在陆周身铺开，潺潺水纹流转，王全力劈砍的长剑落在水幕之上，冲击力被尽数卸掉，连一丝涟漪都没能破开防御。
王浩心头一惊，没想到传闻中的废物纨绔居然拥有如此顶尖的防御功法，不敢耽搁，接连变换招式，猛攻上中下三路，整套强攻打法毫无遗漏，可所有攻势尽数被玄水护罩稳稳格挡，陆站在原地脚步都不曾挪动半步。
僵持数十回合，王灵力消耗大半，气息逐渐紊乱，进攻节奏越来越散乱，心气慢慢急躁。陆看准空档，没有挥剑伤人，只用指尖轻点对方剑身，柔和灵力顺着兵器传导震得王虎口发麻，长剑脱手落在擂台地面。
胜负已定，陆顺势收招后撤，自始至终没有伤到对方分毫，既赢下比试，又完美避开恶意伤人的判罚陷阱。
全场先是死寂一瞬，紧接着哗然四起，先前笃定陆必败的弟子满脸错愕，一个个瞪大眼睛不敢相信眼前结果。高台之上五名收礼裁判脸色一阵青一阵白，抓不到半点违规把柄，只能心不甘情不愿敲响胜利铜锣，宣布陆衍首轮取胜。
王浩垂头丧气走下擂台，找到苏辰面露惭愧，自己拼尽全力没能完成任务，反倒白白输掉比试。苏辰脸色难看，眼底忌惮越来越浓，原本笃定的计划出现重大纰漏，只能默默盘算后续第二轮的针对方案。
比试结束，不少弟子心里的刻板偏见开始松动，零星的质疑声音慢慢在人群里响起：“传闻陆蛮横跋扈、修为稀烂，怎么实战这么稳重，出手还处处留手？”
陆走下擂台，赵小胖兴冲冲迎上来，刚要报喜，一名被陆早年救下的外门弟子匆匆跑来，压低声音禀报：“陆公子，苏安排的造谣小队已经悄悄聚集在广场偏僻角落，正准备散布禁术谣言，咱们埋伏的人已经全部就位，随时可以当场拿人。”
陆微微颔首，不急着收网，打算等到苏后续接连落败、急着动用抹黑手段时再一网打尽。
正当众人沉浸在首轮爆冷的议论中，系统提示音在陆脑海响起。【叮！宿主守礼取胜、出手有度，恪守良心底线，小幅功德入账，天道压制再度削弱4%。】
还没等陆静心消化奖励，赵小胖又带来新消息：“第二轮抽签名单出炉，苏暗中运作，给您安排了第二名老牌强敌，对方同样收了好处，赛前被叮嘱想方设法消耗您体力，伺机制造受伤假象，栽赃您下手狠毒。”
content_en:
: There is only one day left before the Qingxuan Sect's small-scale martial arts competition begins. All the disciples of the entire sect, large and small, gather around the Yanwu Square. The topics discussed in the streets cannot avoid the upcoming arena competition. Under the subtle guidance of public opinion from Heaven, 90% of the monks believed that Su Chen had the destiny, and with the support of many biased referees, it was certain that he would win the top spot. Lu Yan, on the other hand, was still plagued by various rumors. Many people believed in the rumors of forbidden arts and felt that his cultivation was not righteous. After he took the stage, he would soon be beaten down in public and become the laughing stock of the entire sect.
Lu Yan calmly adjusted his condition in the Lu family's villa. After days of polishing, the "Xuanshui Shield" has been used freely. The merits are constantly nourishing the body. It is difficult to find an opponent at the same level as the peak of Qi refining. Beside him, Zhao Xiaopang was holding a thick stack of evidence files. The files were divided into categories to record all the personal and material evidence of Su bribing referees, secretly arranging rumor-mongering thugs, and colluding with Tianjiao to monopolize trial resources. This was the trump card collected by Lu Lienri.
"Young Master, Su was still winning people's hearts in the martial arts field today. Many inner disciples gathered around him, waiting to drink the soup together, hoping to rely on Su's luck to get high-quality training resources." The little fat man reported the latest news one by one, with a face full of indignation, "Why? Some of the referees who were bribed by Su in advance have secretly made secret arrangements for the first round, and have deliberately arranged for you to compete with a veteran talent who is at the peak of Qi refining. They want to use the high-intensity battle in the first round to consume your energy. If there is even the slightest bump in the fight, you will be immediately sentenced to malicious action and violation. "
Lu Yan tapped his fingertips on the table with a calm expression. Su's layout seemed to be comprehensive, but it left flaws everywhere. If the opponent wants to rely on the rules of the referee to set up a situation, he will use defense instead of attack, control the whole process and keep his hands free. He does not rely on brute force to hurt others, but only uses solid skills to win steadily. Even if the referee takes advantage, he cannot make arbitrary penalties in front of the eyes of tens of thousands of disciples.
"We don't need to be disrupted by the opponent's first round of attacks. Let's stick to the original plan and rely on our strength on the field. Outside the field, I have arranged for the outer disciples who have been favored before to be scattered throughout the square. As long as the rumor-mongering gang arranged by Su shows up, they will be caught on the spot." Lu has already laid a dragnet, and Su's plan to smear the backhand after the game has fallen into a trap from the beginning.
After a night's rest, in the early morning of the next day, the Qingxuan Sect's small-scale competition officially began. The huge martial arts square was packed with seats, and seven referees sat down on the high platform one after another. Five of them looked in Su Chen's direction from time to time, implicitly indicating that everything should be done as previously agreed. Su Chen stood in the player area wearing a green shirt, frequently gesturing towards the onlookers. His gentle appearance attracted bursts of applause from the audience. The light golden luck in the sky slowly fell on him, and he continued to accumulate cultivation through the support of the crowd.
The first round of drawing was over, and as expected, Lu Yan's opponent was Wang Hao, the famous inner sect genius. Wang has been involved in sect competitions for many years. He has a solid level of Qi refining and is very capable of ruthless attacks. He has already received the pills sent by Su before the game and privately promised to go on stage to attack with all his strength. He tried every means to lure Lu Yan into a rage and strike. As long as Lu's moves were too heavy, he would immediately signal the referee to impose a penalty.
The moment the lottery results were announced, the whole audience burst into laughter, and the disciples watching the excitement whispered among themselves. "Now that Lu is finished, we will encounter a tough opponent in the first round. I'm afraid I will be defeated miserably if I don't survive ten moves." "Senior Brother Su is so lucky to pick a soft persimmon. He can easily win his first victory. You can tell at a glance."
All kinds of ridiculing words have come and gone, and prejudice has taken root in the hearts of the vast majority of people. Zhao Xiaopang stood beside Lu and clenched his fists angrily. He wanted to speak out to argue, but Lu stretched out his hand to stop him. It's useless to talk too much. The best solution is to break all rumors with results on the stage.
Soon, the first round of the first round began with Su Chen's competition. The opponent's cultivation level was mediocre. With the blessing of heaven's luck, Su's moves were smooth and smooth, and he easily won the victory in two or three moves. After winning, he pretended to be humble, repeatedly praising his opponent's strength, and harvesting the goodwill of the audience. His luck increased slightly again.
When it was Lu Yan's turn to take the stage, the entire audience fell silent for an instant, and all eyes were focused on the stage. Wang Hao walked quickly onto the stage with his long sword in hand, his eyes a bit sinister, and he activated all his spiritual power as soon as he started. The sharp sword moves came one after another crazily, and the sword wind roared, making it clear that he would press forward step by step, forcing Lu Yan to fight back hastily and expose his flaws.
The five bribed referees in the audience leaned slightly forward, staring at the ring, waiting for Lu Danfan to hit the penalty gong immediately. The onlookers held their breath, most of them waiting to see Lu Yan's embarrassing defeat.
Just when the sharp sword edge was about to get close, the shield of light cyan black water spread out all over Lu's body instantly, gurgling water patterns flowed, and Wang's long sword slashed with all his strength fell on the water curtain, all the impact force was removed, and not even a ripple could break the defense.
Wang Hao was shocked. He didn't expect that the rumored good-for-nothing dude actually possessed such top-notch defensive techniques. He didn't dare to delay, and changed his moves one after another, attacking the upper, middle and lower directions. The entire set of strong attack tactics was complete, but all the attacks were firmly blocked by the Xuanshui shield. Lu stood on the spot without moving even half a step.
After dozens of rounds of stalemate, most of Wang's spiritual power was consumed, his breath gradually became disordered, his attack rhythm became more and more scattered, and his heart gradually became irritable. Lu saw the opening and did not swing his sword to hurt anyone. He just tapped the opponent's sword lightly with his fingertips. The soft spiritual power was transmitted along the weapon and made Wang Hu's mouth numb. The sword fell from his hands and fell to the ground of the ring.
With the outcome decided, Lu followed the trend and retreated without injuring his opponent at all. He not only won the match, but also perfectly avoided the penalty trap of malicious injury.
There was a moment of dead silence in the whole place, and then an uproar broke out. The disciples who were previously sure that Lu Bi would be defeated were filled with astonishment, and all of them opened their eyes wide and could not believe the result before them. On the high platform, the five referees who received the gifts looked alternately blue and white. They could not catch any violations, so they could only reluctantly sound the victory gong and announce that Lu Yan had won the first round.
Wang Hao walked down the ring dejectedly and found Su Chen looking ashamed. He tried his best and failed to complete the task, but lost the competition in vain. Su Chen's face was ugly, and the fear in his eyes was getting stronger and stronger. There were major flaws in the originally determined plan, and he could only silently calculate the plan for the second round.
After the competition ended, the stereotypes and prejudices in the hearts of many disciples began to loosen, and sporadic doubts slowly sounded in the crowd: "It is rumored that Lu is domineering and has poor cultivation. How come he is so steady in actual combat and still holds back on his attacks?"
Lu walked off the ring, and Zhao Xiaopang came up to him excitedly. Just when he was about to announce the good news, an outer disciple who had been rescued by Lu in the early years hurried over and reported in a low voice: "Master Lu, the rumor-mongering team arranged by Su has quietly gathered in a remote corner of the square and is preparing to spread rumors about forbidden arts. All our ambush people are in place and can capture people on the spot at any time."
Lu nodded slightly and was not in a hurry to close the net. He planned to wait until Su was defeated one after another and was eager to use smear means to catch them all.
Just as everyone was immersed in the discussion about the first round of upsets, the system prompt sounded in Lu's mind. 【bite! The host obeyed the rules to win, took measures in a measured manner, and adhered to the bottom line of conscience. A small amount of merit was recorded, and the Heavenly Suppression was once again weakened by 4%. 】
Before Lu Jingxin could digest the rewards, Zhao Xiaopang brought new news: "The second round draw list has been released, and Su secretly worked to arrange a second veteran and powerful opponent for you. The opponent also received the benefits. Before the game, he was told to find ways to consume your energy, and to create false impressions of injury and frame you for vicious attacks."
